title: Menstrual Hygiene
summary: Period products include pads, tampons, menstrual cups and period underwear. Change pads every 4–6 hours, tampons at least every 8 hours, and empty and rinse cups regularly.
key_points: Leaving a tampon in too long increases the risk of toxic shock syndrome.
answer_guidance: Explain clearly and simply in the user's language; give steps or examples when the user asks how.
